key_concepts: Water sources can be natural or man-made.
Rivers, lakes, oceans, and rain are natural water sources.
Water pipes are man-made water sources.
Watered plants grow better than unwatered plants.
Animals in different habitats obtain water in different ways.
Humans need water for drinking and staying healthy.
People use water daily for washing, brushing teeth, bathing, and cleaning.
Water conservation is important and people can save water.
